Usage: arcctl journal status
       arcctl journal recover [--run id] [--forward|--back|--leave]

List writes a crash left unfinished, and settle them.

status   lists, for each device arcctl wrote to, the runs that need recovery and
         the last run that changed it. It reads only the journal files.
recover  reads the records of the mouse's unfinished run again and shows what
         each one holds; with --forward, --back or --leave it settles the run.
         Runs whose records all hold the old or all the new bytes are settled
         without asking.

Flags of recover:
  -back
      roll the run back: write what its records held before it
  -forward
      finish the run: write what it meant to leave
  -leave
      record the run as settled and write nothing; refused while a record is
      torn
  -run id
      settle the unfinished run with this id, as 'journal status' names it;
      needed when several are unfinished

Global flags: see 'arcctl help'. Of the write flags, --dry-run and
--allow-foreign-client apply to recover.
